label: Run workflow
description: Execute a workflow (path or id), streaming progress.

args.name: workflow
args.description: workflow path or id

args.name: input
args.description: a workflow input (repeatable)

args.name: secretInputsStdin
args.description: read declared secret inputs from non-TTY stdin

args.name: allowMcpStdio
args.description: authorize a stdio MCP server by its consent digest for this invocation (repeatable)

label: Start chat
description: Start an interactive agent chat session (REPL).

args.name: agent
args.description: bind a specific agent (.agent.yaml path or .relavium/ id)

label: Resume chat
description: Reload a persisted session from history.db and continue the conversation.

args.name: sessionId
args.description: the session to resume

label: List sessions
description: List past agent sessions (id, agent, title, last activity).

label: Export session
description: Export a session to a .relavium.yaml scaffold for review (ADR-0026).

args.name: sessionId
args.description: the session to export

args.name: out
args.description: write the scaffold here instead of <id>.relavium.yaml

args.name: force
args.description: overwrite an existing file at the target path

label: Create (scaffold)
description: Scaffold a new agent or workflow via an interactive wizard.

args.name: force
args.description: overwrite an existing project entry with the same id

label: Export YAML
description: Export a workflow/agent to a portable YAML (secret references stay placeholdered).

args.name: id
args.description: workflow or agent id to export

args.name: out
args.description: write the copy here instead of <id>.<suffix> in cwd

args.name: force
args.description: overwrite an existing file at the target path

label: Import YAML
description: Import an external workflow/agent YAML into the project (validated, deduplicated).

args.name: path
args.description: path to the .relavium.yaml / .agent.yaml file

args.name: force
args.description: overwrite an existing project entry with the same id

label: Run agent (one-shot)
description: Run a single agent one-shot (prompt on stdin); --fixture replays a recorded cassette.

args.name: agent
args.description: agent .agent.yaml path or .relavium/ id

args.name: input
args.description: a session {{ctx.*}} variable (repeatable)

args.name: fixture
args.description: replay a recorded LLM cassette (deterministic, offline)

args.name: allowMcpStdio
args.description: authorize a stdio MCP server by its consent digest for this invocation (repeatable)

label: Resolve gate
description: Resolve a pending human gate (approve / reject / input).

args.name: runId
args.description: the paused run (omit only with the list subcommand)

args.name: approve
args.description: approve the gate

args.name: reject
args.description: reject the gate

args.name: comment
args.description: a decision comment (with --approve / --reject)

args.name: input
args.description: provide input for a gate_type=input gate (JSON, else a raw string)

args.name: gate
args.description: which pending gate to resolve (required when more than one is pending)

args.name: secretStdin
args.description: read the run's secret inputs from stdin as name=value lines (never passed as arguments)

args.name: allowMcpStdio
args.description: authorize a stdio MCP server by its consent digest for this invocation (repeatable)

label: Resolve budget gate
description: Approve the exact frozen microcents or reject a budget gate.

args.name: runId
args.description: the budget-paused run

args.name: approveAmount
args.description: approve exactly the recorded frozen amount (including zero)

args.name: abort
args.description: reject the budget gate without provider or tool execution

args.name: gate
args.description: which budget gate to resolve when multiple are pending

args.name: secretStdin
args.description: read the run's secret inputs from stdin as name=value lines (never passed as arguments)

args.name: allowMcpStdio
args.description: authorize a stdio MCP server by its consent digest for this invocation (repeatable)

label: List gates
description: List pending human gates (all paused runs, or one run).

args.name: runId
args.description: a single run to inspect (omit ⇒ all paused runs)

label: List workflows
description: List discovered workflows (or, with --agents, agents) in the current project.

args.name: agents
args.description: list agents instead of workflows

label: Show run logs
description: Print the persisted event stream for a past run.

args.name: runId
args.description: the run to print

label: Show status
description: Show active/paused runs and their per-node status.

label: List models
description: List the cached model catalog (refreshes on first run if empty).

label: Refresh models
description: Re-fetch what we know about models: each connected provider's live list, and the models.dev catalog.

args.name: providers
args.description: availability only — each connected provider's live model list

args.name: catalog
args.description: metadata only — prices, ceilings and reasoning tiers from models.dev

label: Set model pricing
description: Set your own price for a model — it overrides the catalog (you hold the invoice). --clear removes it.

args.name: model
args.description: the model id to price

args.name: provider
args.description: the provider that serves the model (must be registered)

args.name: input
args.description: input (prompt) price, USD per million tokens — required WITH --output when either is given; omit both to price only media

args.name: output
args.description: output (completion) price, USD per million tokens — required WITH --input when either is given; omit both to price only media

args.name: cached
args.description: cache-read price, USD per million tokens; omitted ⇒ the catalog's cache discount, applied to your input rate

args.name: image
args.description: image-output price, USD per image

args.name: audio
args.description: audio-output price, USD per second

args.name: video
args.description: video-output price, USD per second

args.name: clear
args.description: remove your price for this model — it falls back to the catalog's

label: List providers
description: List registered providers and whether a key is set.

args.name: verify
args.description: additionally run a live key-verification probe per provider

label: Add provider
description: Register a provider.

args.name: name
args.description: provider name (e.g. anthropic)

args.name: baseUrl
args.description: override the provider base URL

args.name: pricingUrl
args.description: override the pricing reference page (where you find model prices)

label: Set provider key
description: Store a provider API key in the OS keychain (the key is read from stdin).

args.name: name
args.description: provider name (e.g. anthropic)

label: Prune legacy media temporaries
description: Remove legacy temporary media after all old producers are stopped.

args.name: legacyOffline
args.description: acknowledge that all old media producers are stopped

args.name: force
args.description: authorize legacy temporary media deletion

label: Remove provider key
description: Remove a provider API key from the OS keychain.

args.name: name
args.description: provider name (e.g. anthropic)

label: Test provider key
description: Verify a provider key with a minimal live request.

args.name: name
args.description: provider name (e.g. anthropic)

args.name: model
args.description: model to test with (defaults to a cheap known model)
